provenance.note: Ratios only. Absolute RPS is not comparable across hosts; these are same-host, same-run ratios against Boehm. Recorded from 48 green master runs on the headerless compile default (2026-09-12/14), which is every green run since #41 flipped the layout plus the 18 dispatched overnight to grow the sample. Tolerance is 3.3 standard deviations: the older max(half-range, 1.5x IQR) rule is proportional to the spread, so it sat about 2.3 sd out at every sample size and could never be gated on. Margins here are 3.34 / 3.45 / 3.35 sd on pct_json, rss_x and pause_p50_ms, i.e. 0.11% combined per run, one false red per ~900 runs, with the gates at 86.84 / 1.143 / 0.960 against fixed floors of 65 / 1.25 / 2.5 — tighter than the floors on all three. Leave-one-out passes 48 of 48, no metric self-fires, and PERF_GATE_BASELINE=1 has been live since 2026-09-13 with ~20 runs and no perf failure. What this cannot catch is a regression under 3.3 sd, ~14 pp of /json here; --prev adds a two-runs-in-a-row check at 2 sd for that. Re-record on the next layout or allocator flip.
